mechanism: Isocarboxazid (MAOI) can inhibit monoamine oxidase metabolism of tyramine and other sympathomimetic amines, and famotidine may have minor effects on gastric pH affecting absorption; additionally, MAOIs can potentiate histamine effects.
action: Monitor for hypertensive episodes and serotonergic symptoms; use famotidine cautiously and consider alternative antacids if possible; ensure patient avoids tyramine-rich foods.
